notes.title: PATCH V1.17 - Bug Fixes & Addition of Vsync Control
notes.content:
* Users can now turn Vsync on/off from the Options menu

Also fixed the following issues:

* Occasional player jitter no longer occurs
* River rapid rafts can no longer clip through the river bank and out the game world
* Movement on the moving Crane Platform on Rush Hour is no longer broken
* Crane movement and river rapid sounds no longer persist during the pause menu

This update also includes general runtime optimisations.

notes.title: PATCH V1.16 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the following issues:


 Bomb-e-Granate is no longer invisible when held underwater
 All sounds are correctly muted when exiting a game now
 Tweaked the audio levels of player VO in Battle Mode
 Stopped players from slowly sliding off screen during the end of Game scene 
 Fixed an issue with Dour Docks sometimes not registering a completed lap in Single Player Mode



This update also includes general runtime optimisations.

Additionally, we have some shiny new banner art for the game's branding! You can feel Pedro's anguish :D

notes.title: PATCH V1.15 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the following issues:


 Pressing Back on Player Select with Player 1 Cancels all Player's Selections
 Keyboard Controls Don't work on Pause Menu
 If You Engage with Gamepad Initially then Keyboard Button Presses on Menu Fail
 Cancelling Selection on Single Player Character Select Spawns P1 Prefabs
 Choosing No when Unlocking Outfit also Goes Back a Screen
 Numpad 0 is listed as both Use and Discard for Keyboard controls
 User was Unable to Unlock Outfit even with Enough Moustachios
 Textures on Terrain lose Blending at Full Resolution


This update also includes general runtime optimisations.

notes.title: PATCH V1.14 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Gold outfits will now correctly unlock once criteria to do so has been met
 The Mini Tour Cup Tourney will no longer enter an indefinite unresponsive state after the Lost Islands Race
 Updated some incorrect German translations
 The Mouse Cursor will now be automatically hidden at all times
 Fixed a bug with outfit unlock UI occasionally remaining on screen indefinitely

notes.title: PATCH V1.12 - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
D-Pad will again correctly control the main menus
 A french string on the Battle Game Settings screen no longer wraps incorrectly
 When exiting and re-opening Graphics Options, the currently selected option will correctly begin at the top again
 Fixed an issue with languages being accidentally changed when moving up and down on the main menu

notes.title: PATCH V1.11 - Fixed Missing How to Play Guides
notes.content:
Thanks to DamageInc for raising these issues!


 The detailed descriptions for each game mode in the How to play section are no longer invisible
 The screen resolution on first load should default to full screen now* and should respect any settings you change in Options > Graphics on each subsequent launch
 Using a controller to adjust screen resolution in Options > Graphics whilst in Windowed mode will no longer inadvertently cycle through the choices


*Note: because of how Unity works, you may have to delete the miniBeast Game Studios folder in Registry Editor prior to launching the game to see this update have an effect. This should only be a one-time requirement.

notes.title: PATCH V1.10 - Fixed Critical Bug with Single Player Mode
notes.content:
Single Player mode can now be launched again as normal


Thanks a bunch to Charlotte Benoit (@OniOnidra) for flagging this issue! It was something that had slipped through the net as a result of some recent changes to the Input system.
